shots.name: k1
shots.prompt: Wide shot on a school athletics track in warm late-afternoon light. Elif, a 15-year-old girl with dark hair in a high ponytail and a plain number-free navy sports kit, finishes a run in the red lane, breathing hard; the coach, a man in his forties in a light grey polo with a clipboard at his hip, watches from the side and nods. Low sun, long shadows, green fence and sports field behind, plain school building in the distance. Vertical composition.

Medium shot: Elif stands on the track, hands on her knees, catching her breath; she looks up toward the coach with a small tired smile. Warm backlight on the red track. Vertical composition.
